name: Shouyao Holdings (Beijing) Co., LTD.
summary: Shouyao Holdings (Beijing) Co., LTD. engages in the research, development, and production of drugs in China. The company offers drugs for oncology indications, including non-small cell lung cancer, lymphoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, pancreatic cancer, breast cancer, ovarian cancer, thyroid cancer, leukemia, and diabetes. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
